rows.grounds: fused atra+anuktaṃ; unstated items in this context
fused yat+sarvaṃ; all that remains unstated
optative of nī; directs handling of unstated items

items.question: How should ritual details left unstated here be handled in this homa procedure?
premises: unstated items remain after the stated homa rules
they are to be led like linga installation
the directive applies to whatever is all unstated
items.inference: Any unstated ritual detail should be handled by analogy with linga installation.
uncertainties: exact scope of liṅgasthāpana analogy is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: But whatever is unstated here, lead it like linga installation.
